name: Belmond Cap Juluca
positioning: Beach resort of rooms, suites and villas on Maundays Bay, Anguilla, with a Guerlain-serviced spa and several restaurants
best_for: Beach-stay travelers who want a beach view from every room, suite or villa

facts.text: The resort sits on Maundays Bay, a crescent-shaped cove on Anguilla.
Every room, suite and villa has a beach view.
Stays range from a beachfront room to a casita with a private pool to a five-bedroom signature villa.
Villa host services are available 24 hours.
The resort has two tennis courts.
Yoga is held on the beach or in the gardens.
Beach activities include paddle surfing, kayaking, kite surfing, sailing and snorkelling.
Spa treatments use locally sourced ingredients such as Anguillan salt.
Pimms serves Anguillan dishes and Uchu serves Peruvian light bites.
A kids club keeps children aged 4 to 12 busy with educational and interactive activities.

highlights.text: Nightly sabrage ceremonies are held in the Main House, where a select number of guests saber a bottle of bubbly.
The owners named the property Juluca after the Arawak rainbow spirit.
The spa is inspired by the Arawak tribe and serviced by Guerlain.
The interactive chef's table is a nine-course feast.
The Cap Shack is a toes-in-the-sand spot on the opposite side of the cove.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and a remote Caribbean island location.
Specially adapted rooms are available upon request.
Only a select number of guests get to saber a bottle at the nightly sabrage ceremony.
